name: Shadow Hold
summary: In the depths of Jaedenar, the Shadow Council holds Shadow Hold as its chief stronghold on Kalimdor. The cult rules from a defiled night elf barrow den beneath Felwood's blighted canyon.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body: Beneath Jaedenar's corrupted red earth, Shadow Hold's corridors wind through an ancient night elf barrow den. Druids once slept here while tending the Emerald Dream. Now warlocks and demonic servants stalk its twisted passages by fel fire. Lord Banehollow, Prince Xavalis, and Shadow Lord Fel'dan command a formidable force in the deepest tiers. From here, demonic power holds its chief seat in the region.

sections.title: Horrors in the Deep
sections.body:
The Shadow Council directs its corruption of Felwood from the caverns and tortures its prisoners. Among those taken deep inside were Arko'narin Starshade, a night elf, and Trey Lightforge, a human paladin.

Arko'narin survived after a timely rescue, but the cult tortured Trey to death. His spirit was briefly twisted to malice before he was laid to rest. The Emerald Circle and local shamans still work to pierce the dark barriers around the hold and strike down its demonic masters.

faq.q: What was Shadow Hold before the Shadow Council took it over?
faq.answer: Before the Shadow Council seized Shadow Hold, it was an ancient night elf barrow den. Druids slept there as they tended the land and their communion with the Emerald Dream. After the Third War and Felwood's demonic corruption, the cult took the complex and defiled its sacred halls into a fel fortress.

aliases: who is in charge of shadow hold
faq.answer: Lord Banehollow oversees Shadow Hold with his lieutenants, the satyr Prince Xavalis and the warlock Shadow Lord Fel'dan. Fel'dan commands the mortal cultists.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer infiltrate Shadow Hold peacefully?
faq.answer: Those who practice the dark arts may enter Shadow Hold disguised as loyal cultists to seek summoning reagents such as Xorothian Stardust. Lord Banehollow permits trade with outsiders only after they prove their loyalty by rooting out spies and traitors among his ranks.

faq.q: What happened to the captives in the hold?
faq.answer: The Shadow Council captured Arko'narin Starshade, a night elf, and Trey Lightforge, a paladin, while they scouted the cult. The cultist Rakaiah tortured Trey to death. Adventurers rescued Arko'narin from her cage and later recovered Trey's remains for a proper burial.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can seek rare demonic reagents such as Xorothian Stardust in Shadow Hold's deepest recesses. Lord Banehollow grants access only to those who win his favor through cunning infiltration.
As a night elf, you find an ancestral barrow den defiled by fel sludge and demonic rituals. Imprisonment cages fill the hold.
